title: The Kind Mix-Up
subtitle: A Sparklight adventure with Moki
synopsis: Something feels tangled. Moki helps turn a confusing mix-up into a clearer pattern — with kindness, never mean jokes. Heartlights stay essence, not separate pets.

nodes.title: Pixels out of place
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
Checker-scarf Moki bounces in place. Sparklight flickers like a puzzle that won't sit still.

"Something's mixed up," Moki grins. "Not broken. Just… rearrangeable."

choices.label: Make a kind joke first (with Moki)
choices.memory: We laughed kindly at a mix-up.
choices.line: Spot the mix-up. Check it kindly. Try a new idea.

choices.label: Ask Lumo to map the tangle
choices.memory: We mapped the mix-up like a co-op quest.

nodes.title: Soft sparkle joke
nodes.speaker: moki
nodes.body:
"What if the mix-up is just a sock that thinks it's a hat?" Moki's joke is gentle — never about a person.

The tangle loosens a little. Sparklight rearranges into a clearer star.

choices.label: Check the idea carefully
choices.memory: We checked the idea carefully after laughing.

choices.label: Ask Lila to put the feeling into words

nodes.title: Questlight map
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body: Lumo taps the crystal controller. "Three safe tiles: notice, name, try one new idea. No rush mode."

choices.label: If it feels too big, ask a trusted adult
choices.memory: We chose Safety First — asked a trusted adult.

nodes.title: Dreamlight words
nodes.speaker: lila
nodes.body:
Luna's ribbons sketch the tangle as a cloud with a door.

"Naming it doesn't erase it. It gives you a handle."

nodes.title: Trusted hand
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body: Questlight glows warm. "Best co-op move sometimes is inviting a trusted adult. That isn't quitting — that's leveling up the party."

choices.label: Thank the crew and keep glowing

nodes.title: Clearer pattern
nodes.speaker: moki
nodes.body:
The pixels settle. Sparklight is still Moki's essence — not a separate creature — just brighter.

"Plot twist solved. Kindly."

choices.label: Celebrate the clear pattern
choices.memory: We cleared a mix-up with kindness.

choices.label: Wonder what else we might notice

nodes.title: Sparklight steady
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body: You and the crew made confusion smaller without making anyone small. Heartlights glow as essence — who each Lumming is.

nodes.title: More sparks ahead
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body: The path is clearer, and curiosity stays soft. More adventures wait when you're ready.
